name: Tsubomi Gumi
source:
"Yeah, I admit it. I was the one who secretly took the photos. What of it?"
[[i]Think you've got anything on me?[/i]]

Gumi is a third year student from Class D. She is an otaku girl who doesn't stand out in class. She speaks in a curt manner and doesn't get along well with her friends. She is good at handling computers and even hacked into the personal tablet provided by the school.

[Translated from [url=https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/hobe_0406/]DMM[/url] and the [url=https://www.nitroplus.co.jp/game/mojika/]official website[/url]]
